rav-huna-misura.name: Rav Huna from Sura
rav-huna-misura.bio: Babylonian Amora named for the town of Sura, cited in the Talmud as Rav Huna MiSura.
rav-huna-misura.prompt: A Babylonian sage in his 50s with a greying brown beard and a russet wool mantle, holding up one hand as he offers a proof from a baraita; background of a mud-brick study hall by a river, lit by an oil lamp.

rabbi-shemaya.name: Rabbi Shemaya
rabbi-shemaya.bio: Amora cited in the Talmud by this name.
rabbi-shemaya.prompt: A sage in his 40s with a short black beard and a slate-blue wool mantle, pointing to a line in an open scroll as he cites a teaching; background of a plain study hall with stone walls and a single oil lamp.
